common.reviewNotes:
1. SCREEN RECORDING
A screen recording on a physical iPhone (latest iOS) is attached to our reply in App Review.

2. PURPOSE AND TARGET AUDIENCE
Calorie Diet Log ("カロリーごはん帳") is a simple food diary for general users, designed especially for older adults and people who are not comfortable with smartphones (large text, few buttons). Users take a photo of a meal to see an estimated calorie count, and record meals, weight, water and a salt guide. Problem it solves: keeping a food/weight diary is tedious; this app makes it one tap. A weekly/monthly summary can be shown to a doctor or sent to family/carers.

3. HOW TO USE (no login, no account, no sample files needed)
- On first launch, answer 3 short questions (buddy character, height/weight, daily calorie goal) and tap Start.
- Home > "Take a photo": take or choose a photo of food. The dish is recognized on the device and candidates are shown. Pick one, choose Small/Regular/Large and which meal, then Save. The buddy character reacts.
- Home > "Log without a photo": pick a dish from the list or enter one manually.
- Home > "More": today's log & salt, weight (with graph), water, weekly/monthly summary (print/PDF), send summary to family/carer (system share sheet, only when the user taps Send), and Settings (text size, language Japanese/English, buddy, goals, mealtime reminders).
- Calorie values are clearly labeled as estimates. If the user selects "My doctor gave me a number", the app never changes that goal.

4. EXTERNAL SERVICES
- Google AdMob: banner ad at the bottom and at most one interstitial per day (only after saving a meal or opening the summary, never during input). No App Tracking Transparency prompt; no tracking.
- On-device food recognition: Google "AIY Vision Classifier Food V1" model (Apache License 2.0) bundled in the app and run with TensorFlow.js (Apache License 2.0). Photos are never uploaded.
- No login/authentication service, no payment processor, no cloud AI service, no server of our own. All records are stored only on the device.

5. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
None. The app works the same in all regions. UI language follows the device (Japanese or English) and can be changed in Settings.

6. REGULATED INDUSTRY / THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL
The app is not a medical device and does not diagnose or treat any condition; it shows estimates and tells users to follow their doctor's advice. Character art and the app icon were provided by the developer. The bundled recognition model and libraries are open source under the Apache License 2.0. No other third-party protected material is used.

ja.name: カロリーごはん帳
ja.subtitle: 写真でカロリーの目安がわかる
ja.keywords: カロリー,食事記録,ダイエット,体重,塩分,水分,写真,ごはん,健康,シニア,高齢者,介護,記録
ja.promotionalText: 食事の写真を撮るだけで、おおよそのカロリーがわかります。文字が大きく、ボタンも少なめ。スマホが苦手な方でも使いやすいアプリです。
ja.description:
「カロリーごはん帳」は、食事の写真を撮るだけで、おおよそのカロリーがわかる食事記録アプリです。
文字は大きく、ボタンは少なめ。スマホが苦手な方や、ご年配の方でも「ちょっと触ってみよう」と思えるように作りました。

■ 写真でカロリーの目安
料理の写真を撮ると、なんの料理かをスマホの中で調べて、カロリーの目安を表示します。量は「小盛り・普通・大盛り」から選ぶだけ。写真は外部に送りません。
写真を撮り忘れたときは、料理を選ぶか、自分で入力して記録できます。

■ 毎日の記録
・1日の目標カロリーと、残りのカロリー
・塩分の目安
・水分（コップ1杯ずつ）
・体重とグラフ
・連続記録日数
・食事の時間のお知らせ

■ お医者さんの指示にも
目標カロリーは「自分で決めた」か「医師から指示された」かを分けて記録できます。医師の指示のときは、アプリが勝手に目標を変えることはありません。
1週間・1か月のまとめは、受診のときに先生に見せたり、印刷したりできます。

■ 家族・ケアマネにも
ご本人が許可した人にだけ、まとめを送れます。

■ いっしょに記録するなかま
男の人・女の人・くまから選べます。食べすぎた日はお腹パンパン、ちょうど良い日はニコニコ、足りない日はお腹がグ〜。痩せすぎると元気がなくなります。

■ ご注意
写真や料理表から出すカロリー・塩分は、あくまで目安です。医師から食事の指示を受けている方は、その指示を優先してください。

無料版には広告が表示されます。

en-US.name: Calorie Diet Log
en-US.subtitle: Snap a meal, see the calories
en-US.promotionalText: Just take a photo of your meal to see a rough calorie count. Big text and few buttons make it easy for anyone, even if smartphones aren't your thing.
en-US.description:
Calorie Diet Log is a simple food diary: take a photo of your meal and see a rough calorie estimate.
The text is large and there are only a few buttons, so it's easy to use even if you're not comfortable with smartphones.

■ Calorie estimates from photos
Take a photo of your dish and the app works out what it is — right on your phone — and shows an estimated calorie count. Just choose Small, Regular or Large. Your photos never leave your phone.
Forgot to take a photo? Pick the dish from a list or type it in.

■ Daily records
・Daily calorie goal and calories left
・Salt guide
・Water (one glass at a time)
・Weight with a graph
・Logging streak
・Mealtime reminders

■ Works with your doctor's advice
Record whether your calorie goal is your own or from your doctor. If it's from your doctor, the app never changes it on its own.
Show your weekly or monthly summary to your doctor at check-ups, or print it.

■ Share with family or carers
Send your summary only to the people you allow.

■ A food buddy
Choose a man, a woman or a bear. On days you overeat your buddy looks stuffed, on good days it smiles, and when you haven't eaten enough its tummy rumbles. If you get too thin, it loses its energy.

■ Please note
Calories and salt from photos and the food list are estimates only. If your doctor has given you dietary advice, please follow it first.

The free version shows ads.
